Definition: Email fields must pass syntax validation and optional deliverability checks.
Phone numbers must normalize to E.164 when country context is known.
A lead requires at least one configured identity method.
Stage effective dates cannot precede opportunity creation.
Win probability must be between 0 and 100 percent.
Opportunity and proposal monetary values must use tenant-supported currency and nonnegative amounts.
Proposal expiration must be after issue date.
Signature recipients require validated identity and signing role.
Consent effective date cannot be after revocation date.
Automated outbound messages must pass recipient local-time quiet-hour checks.
Assigned owners must be active and authorized for the record scope.
A contact-account relationship must not duplicate the same role and effective dates.
A referral cannot refer itself or create a cyclic parent chain.
Review ratings must fall within the source system scale.
Warranty request date must be evaluated against coverage dates and exception policy.
Portal uploads must pass file type, size, malware, and retention validation.
All required template variables must resolve before send or generation.
Forecast snapshots require a valid fiscal period.
A completed signature event cannot be replayed.
Create and send endpoints require supported idempotency keys.
Every persistent record requires a valid tenant identifier.
Controlled status values must exist in the active configuration version.
Proposal options in one proposal version must use the same currency.
Records under legal hold or active contract linkage cannot be permanently deleted.
